name: Apartmenthaus Nr. 1
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Apartmenthaus Nr. 1 is located in the heart of Lienz, just a few minutes’ walk from the pedestrian zone. The apartments feature a practical layout with a separate living area and small kitchen, ideal for self-caterers. The stunning Osttiroler Bergwelt of the Dolomites is easily accessible from the house, perfect for hiking in the summer or skiing in the Skigebiet Zettersfeld in winter. Parking is available nearby.
